name: Encostas d'Aire

communes: Freixianda, Ribeira Do Farrio E Formigais
Porto De Mós - São João Baptista E São Pedro
Rio De Couros E Casal Dos Bernardos
Santa Catarina Da Serra E Chainça
Santiago E S.Simão De Litém E Albergaria Dos Doze

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Sémillon, Cabernet Franc, Tempranillo, Dolcetto and Merlot fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Limestone makes alkaline soil that drains well yet can hold water for the vines. It is usually planted to grapes valued for their acidity.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: The high ground runs about 4°F cooler than the low ground. Higher vineyards ripen later and keep more acidity, so one grape can make lighter or richer wine here depending on height.
Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
